legal.bagPolicy.content: Sunset Festival is a fictional event in a demo project, so no bag policy applies. The Terms of use cover the use of the application, and the Privacy policy covers your data.
legal.bagPolicy.heading: SUNSET FESTIVAL BAG POLICY
legal.bagPolicy.title: Bag policy
legal.privacyPolicy.content:
The data controller is Mikołaj Gawron, the author of Sunset Festival, a demo project built for learning and as a portfolio piece. The festival does not take place, and the shop neither fulfils orders nor takes payments. Contact: gawrmiko@gmail.com.

We process your account data (email address, name, and a password stored only as a hash in Keycloak, the sign-in service running on the author's server), your shipping address, your orders and your wishlist. We process them only to run the application, under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR, that is to provide the service you use.

The data is stored in databases on the author's private server in the European Union. It is never sold or shared with anyone else. Account emails are sent by an external mail provider (Resend), which receives only the recipient's address and the message and may process them outside the European Economic Area under standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

We keep the data until your account is deleted. The newsletter sign-up is disabled in this version, so it collects no addresses. As this is a demo project, data may also be deleted earlier, for example when the database is reset.

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict its processing, to data portability and to object. To exercise them, write to gawrmiko@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority; in Poland, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO).

Providing the data is voluntary, but an account cannot be created without it. No decisions about you are based solely on automated processing, including profiling.

The application uses only the cookies it needs for the session and sign-in. The cart is kept only in your browser's storage. There is no analytics and no advertising.

legal.termsOfUse.content:
Sunset Festival is a demo project Mikołaj Gawron built for learning and as part of his portfolio. The event, the artists, the tickets and the products in the shop are fictional: no order is ever fulfilled or charged.

The application is free to use. You create and manage your account through Keycloak, a sign-in service running on the author's server. When you sign up you accept these terms and confirm that you have read the privacy policy; the date of acceptance is stored with your account.

Do not enter real payment details or anything you would not want stored on the author's server.

The application is provided as is, with no guarantee that it is available or works correctly. The author may change it, reset its data or shut it down at any time.

Accounts and content that break the law or are used for abuse may be removed.

Questions and reports: gawrmiko@gmail.com.
